title: Regional Audit Retention Enforcer with HSM Anchoring and Exportable Evidence
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement an enforcement service that guarantees admin/audit event residency and retention policy compliance by producing append-only, cryptographically-anchored WORM bundles that are stamped via HSM and can be exported for legal/forensic requests. The service must integrate with the audit capture pipeline, the Private deployment residency registry, and the Console export UI/ APIs.

Scope:
- Residency-aware policy enforcement (per-tenant, per-org region constraints)
- Retention policy evaluation and automated retention lifecycle (retain/delete/escrow)
- WORM packaging: immutable bundle creation, manifest generation, HSM timestamp anchoring, and tamper-evidence proofs
- Evidence export API with signed manifests and verification helpers for customers and legal
- Observability: retention compliance dashboard, alerts for policy violations, and periodic integrity checks

Out of scope: long-term escrow storage vendor procurement (we provide hooks), legal export format approval (legal will sign off).
acceptance_criteria:
1) For a tenant bound to region EU-W, generated audit bundles contain only EU-resident artifacts and metadata that prove origin region.
2) Bundles are created as append-only artifacts (no server-side mutation API) and carry an HSM-signed timestamp anchor stored alongside the bundle manifest.
3) Retention policies are evaluated nightly and items past retention are either moved to escrow or flagged for deletion according to tenant policy.
4) Console export API returns a signed manifest and a URL to download the bundle; a verification script validates HSM signature and integrity hash.
5) Alerts fire when any bundle contains records from outside declared residency or when HSM signing fails.
6) Unit and integration tests cover policy evaluation, bundle creation, signing, and export flows.
implementation_notes:
Architecture proposal: add a new component AuditRetentionEnforcer (ARE) that subscribes to the audit-event-log topic after the capture layer. ARE responsibilities: policy resolution (lookup tenant residency/retention), assemble incremental append-only bundle shards, periodically flush shard -> create immutable bundle + manifest, request HSM timestamp + signature, persist bundle to regional object store with 'sealed' ACL, emit bundle metadata event to audit-index.

Key design decisions:
- Use object store immutability + server-side ACLs + HSM-signed manifest to achieve WORM semantics (we do not expect object-store WORM features in all regions).
- Bundles are chunked (max 10GB) to support streaming export and reduce memory pressure.
- Manifest format is JSON-LD to allow structured claims (residency, clock, signer, chunk hashes).
- HSM integration will use PKCS#11 backing a signing key managed by Redwood KMS; fallback to soft-signing in test/dev.

Data formats: example audit record line (newline-delimited JSON):
{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:22:35Z","tenant_id":"org_456","actor":"admin:alice","action":"grant_role","target":"user:bob","region":"eu-west-1"}

Manifest example (stringified for tests):
{"bundle_id":"bndl-20260310-0001","tenant_id":"org_456","region":"eu-west-1","chunks":[{"path":"s3://eu-audit/bndl-20260310-0001/c1","sha256":"..."}],"hsm_signature":"base64(...)","timestamp":"2026-03-10T14:25:00Z"}

Operational considerations: rate-limit signing requests, backoff for HSM unavailability, and an emergency fallback that writes the bundle to a secure escrow queue (encrypted) while alerting SRE.
migration_steps:
1) Feature-flag ARE behind 'audit-retention-enforcer' flag per cluster.
2) Start in read-only verification mode: ARE will create manifests for test bundles but not seal them.
3) Enable HSM signing in a single EU region and run canary with three tenants.
4) Ramp to all EU tenants, then roll to NA regions.
5) Coordinate with legal and compliance for export format acceptance and retention classifications.

Rollback: toggle feature flag off; ERA will stop sealing new bundles and continue to serve verification endpoints. Existing sealed bundles remain immutable.
monitoring_runbook:
Essential metrics: bundles_created_total, bundle_sign_failures_total, bundle_integrity_check_failures, policy_violation_count, escrow_queue_depth.
Alerts:
- P1: HSM signing failure rate > 1% for 5m -> pages SRE and Security.
- P1: Any bundle that includes non-resident records -> pages Compliance owner + SRE.
- P2: escrow_queue_depth > 1000 -> SRE.
Runbook steps: check HSM health, inspect signing queue, requeue failed shards, escalate to on-call HSM operator, initiate manual verification via verification tool (link in links).

notes_for_reviewers: Please focus on policy resolution edge-cases: multi-region tenants, orgs with mixed residency requirements, and the escrow fallback encryption key rotation.
